an6.56:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tena kho pana samayena āyasmā phagguṇo ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
an6.56:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.56:1.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā yenāyasmā phagguṇo tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an6.56:1.6: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā phagguṇo tenupasaṅkami.
an6.56:1.7: addasā kho āyasmā phagguṇo bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
an6.56:1.9: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ etadavoca:
an6.56:1.10: alaṃ phagguṇa, mā tvaṃ mañcake samañcosi.
an6.56:1.11: santimāni āsanāni pure paññattāni, tatthāhaṃ nisīdissāmīti.
an6.56:1.13: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ etadavoca:
an6.56:2.1: “kacci te phagguṇa khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
an6.56:2.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamantī, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:3.1: seyyathāpi bhante, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhānaṃ abhimantheyya evameva kho me bhante adhimattā vātā muddhānaṃ hananti.
an6.56:3.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:4.1: seyyathāpi bhante balavā puriso daḷhena varattabandhena sīse sīsaveṭhanaṃ dadeyya, evameva kho me bhante, adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā,
an6.56:4.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:5.1: seyyathāpi bhante, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evameva kho me bhante, adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
an6.56:5.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:6.1: seyyathāpi bhante, balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānā bāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ paritāpeyyuṃ evameva kho me bhante adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
an6.56:6.2: na me bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamoti.
an6.56:6.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ phagguṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an6.56:7.1: atha kho āyasmā phagguṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi.
an6.56:7.2: tamhi cassa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsu.
an6.56:7.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.56:7.5: tamhi cassa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsūti.
an6.56:8.1: kiṃ hānanda phagguṇassa bhikkhuno indriyāni nappasīdissanti,
an6.56:8.2: phagguṇassa ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ ahosi.
an6.56:8.3: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
an6.56:9.1: chayime ānanda ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena atthūpaparikkhāya.
an6.56:9.3: idhānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:9.4: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
an6.56:9.5: tassa tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti: ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:9.6: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saññājanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:9.7: ayaṃ ānanda paṭhamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe. (2)
an6.56:10.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saññojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:10.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na heva kho labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya, api ca kho tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:10.3: tassa tathāgatasāvako dhammaṃ deseti: ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:10.4: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:10.5: ayaṃ ānanda dutiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe. (3)
an6.56:11.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:11.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na heva kho labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya, napi tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:11.3: api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, manasānupekkhati.
an6.56:11.4: tassa yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato manasānupekkhato pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:11.5: ayaṃ ānanda tatiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe kālena atthūpaparikkhāya. (4)
an6.56:12.1: idhānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, anuttare ca kho upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:12.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya,
an6.56:12.3: tassa tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti: ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:12.4: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anuttare kho upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:12.5: ayaṃ ānanda catuttho ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe. (5)
an6.56:13.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti. anuttare ca kho upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti
an6.56:13.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na heva kho labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya, api ca kho tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:13.3: tassa tathāgata sāvako dhammaṃ deseti: ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
an6.56:13.4: tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:13.5: ayaṃ ānanda pañcamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe. (6)
an6.56:14.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi oramhāgiyehi sayojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti. anuttare ca kho upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:14.2: so tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na heva kho labhati tathāgataṃ dassanāya, napi tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:14.3: api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
an6.56:14.4: tassa yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato manasānupekkhato anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:14.5: ayaṃ ānanda chaṭṭho ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe kālena atthūpaparikkhāya.
an6.56:15.1: ime kho ānanda cha ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavaṇe kālena atthūpaparikkhāyāti.
